latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Customer Journey Mapper.
- Enables mapping of the full ecommerce customer journey from brand discovery to repeat purchase.
- Identifies customer touchpoints, friction points, and surfaces actionable optimization opportunities.
- Structures journey maps by stage with prioritized recommendations and a summary health scorecard.
- Requires store URL and conversion data; optional support for customer feedback and target persona input.
- Platform-agnostic and designed for ecommerce operators, DTC brands, and growth marketers.
